import ctypes,hashlib,json,os,shutil,signal,struct,subprocess,sys,tarfile,time,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools'))
from mcc_loading_presentation import read_media,V3_FRAMES,V3_PCM_SHA
work=Path(os.environ['HALO2_TEST_SCRATCH']);out=root/'build/test-results/macos-vorbis-work';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
report={'schema':'H2_VORBIS_ACTIVE_ARITHMETIC_OWNER_V1','scratch':str(work),'runs':[],'retained_large_artifacts':[]}
def save():(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
def digest(p):return hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
def run(command,log,env=None):
 command=list(map(str,command))
 with log.open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(command,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,timeout=90)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(log.read_text()[-6000:])
 return command
class Lookup(ctypes.Structure):
 _fields_=[('n',ctypes.c_int),('log2n',ctypes.c_int),('trig',ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)),('bitrev',ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)),('scale',ctypes.c_float)]
def configure(lib):
 lib.mdct_init.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(Lookup),ctypes.c_int]
 lib.mdct_clear.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(Lookup)]
 lib.mdct_backward.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(Lookup),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)]
 return lib
reference=configure(ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libvorbis.so.0'))
def mdct_compare(lib):
 metrics=[];seed=0x98723541
 for n in (256,2048):
  lookup=Lookup();reference.mdct_init(ctypes.byref(lookup),n)
  try:
   for case in range(4):
    values=[]
    for i in range(n//2):
     seed^=(seed<<13)&0xffffffff;seed^=seed>>17;seed^=(seed<<5)&0xffffffff
     word=(seed&0x807fffff)|((105 if case<2 else 120)<<23)
     values.append(struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<I',word))[0])
    original=(ctypes.c_float*(n//2))(*values);a=(ctypes.c_float*n)();b=(ctypes.c_float*n)()
    reference.mdct_backward(ctypes.byref(lookup),original,a)
    original=(ctypes.c_float*(n//2))(*values)
    lib.mdct_backward(ctypes.byref(lookup),original,b)
    aa=bytes(a);bb=bytes(b);diff=[(i,x[0],y[0]) for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(struct.iter_unpack('<I',aa),struct.iter_unpack('<I',bb))) if x!=y]
    metrics.append({'n':n,'case':case,'differing_words':len(diff),'reference_sha256':hashlib.sha256(aa).hexdigest(),'candidate_sha256':hashlib.sha256(bb).hexdigest(),'first_differences':[{'index':i,'reference':f'{x:08x}','candidate':f'{y:08x}'} for i,x,y in diff[:4]]})
  finally:reference.mdct_clear(ctypes.byref(lookup))
 return metrics
try:
 media=work/'loading.wem';media.write_bytes(read_media(Path('/home/eric/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Halo The Master Chief Collection/halo2'))[0])
 converter=root/'build/halo2_mcc_loading_audio';books=root/'external/ww2ogg/packed_codebooks_aoTuV_603.bin'
 archive=work/'vorbis.tar.xz'
 with urllib.request.urlopen('https://ftp.osuosl.org/pub/xiph/releases/vorbis/libvorbis-1.3.7.tar.xz',timeout=30) as response,archive.open('wb') as stream:shutil.copyfileobj(response,stream)
 assert digest(archive)=='b33cc4934322bcbf6efcbacf49e3ca01aadbea4114ec9589d1b1e9d20f72954b'
 with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:tar.extractall(work,filter='data')
 source=work/'libvorbis-1.3.7'
 objects=work/'objects';objects.mkdir()
 names='smallft envelope window lsp lpc analysis synthesis psy info floor1 floor0 res0 mapping0 registry codebook sharedbook lookup bitrate'.split()
 includes=['-I'+str(source/'include'),'-I'+str(source/'lib')]
 common=[]
 for name in names:
  obj=objects/(name+'.o');run(['gcc','-c','-fPIC','-O3','-ffp-contract=off',*includes,source/'lib'/(name+'.c'),'-o',obj],work/'compile.log');common.append(obj)
 report.update(ready=True,source=str(source),common_flags=['gcc','-O3','-ffp-contract=off'])
 save();print(json.dumps({'ready':True,'scratch':str(work),'source':str(source)}),flush=True)
 deadline=time.monotonic()+1500;last=0
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  commandpath=work/'command.json'
  if not commandpath.exists():time.sleep(.1);continue
  command=json.loads(commandpath.read_text());commandpath.unlink()
  if command.get('action')=='stop':report['stopped']=True;break
  label=command['label'];assert label.replace('-','').replace('_','').isalnum()
  folder=work/label;folder.mkdir()
  compiler=command.get('compiler','gcc');flags=command.get('flags',['-O3','-ffp-contract=off'])
  inputs=[]
  for name in ('mdct','block'):
   selected=Path(command.get(name,str(source/'lib'/(name+'.c'))));assert selected.is_relative_to(work)
   obj=folder/(name+'.o');run([compiler,'-c','-fPIC',*flags,*includes,selected,'-o',obj],folder/(name+'.log'));inputs.append(obj)
  for i,extra in enumerate(command.get('extra',[])):
   selected=Path(extra);assert selected.is_relative_to(work);obj=folder/('extra'+str(i)+'.o');run([compiler,'-c','-fPIC',*flags,*includes,selected,'-o',obj],folder/('extra'+str(i)+'.log'));inputs.append(obj)
  library=folder/'libvorbis.so.0';link=run([compiler,'-shared','-Wl,-Bsymbolic',*inputs,*common,'-o',library,'-logg','-lm','-ldl'],folder/'link.log')
  lib=configure(ctypes.CDLL(str(library)))
  metrics=mdct_compare(lib)
  output=folder/'loading.wav';run([converter,media,output,books,V3_FRAMES],folder/'decode.log',dict(os.environ,LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(folder)))
  sha=hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()[44:]).hexdigest()
  row={'label':label,'command':command,'library_sha256':digest(library),'mdct':metrics,'mdct_differing_words':sum(v['differing_words'] for v in metrics),'pcm_sha256':sha,'matches_canonical':sha==V3_PCM_SHA}
  output.unlink();report['runs'].append(row);save()
  print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k not in ('mdct','command')}),flush=True)
 else:raise TimeoutError('Owned arithmetic investigation deadline')
except BaseException as e:report.update(error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:6000])
finally:save()
sys.exit(0 if report.get('stopped') else 1)

conclusions: Both actual decoder builds use identical 256- and 2048-point coefficient tables and identical transform inputs for the first twelve transforms; the outputs differ from the first inverse transform.
Replacing only mdct_backward and vorbis_synthesis_blockin in an otherwise strict rebuilt library with the retained reference-library implementations reproduces the full admitted PCM hash.
Explicitly fusing the visible product pairs and the tested compiler contraction policies do not reproduce that reference. These are diagnostic controls, not a production numerical fix.
No production PCM hash, codec arithmetic policy or deferred original engine x87/SSE code changed.
